parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved metal rod attached to the upper rim of the bucket, allowing it to be carried easily.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting and carrying the bucket, transferring the load from the base body to the user's hand.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to swing freely for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the bucket is a hollow cylindrical container made of plastic, designed to hold liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main storage compartment of the bucket, containing the material being carried or stored.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, providing structural support and volume for the bucket’s contents.
